name: Eloria
summary: Eloria stands with sculptural confidence, its tripod base crafted from stainless steel in a deep black nickel finish. The surface is subtly brushed, creating a play of shadow and texture that catches the light with quiet sophistication. Minimalist yet striking, Eloria embodies modern refinement expressed through form and detail.
